caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a bonnet, which is positioned prominently against a plain, light beige background. The bonnet is rendered in a deep red or burgundy color and is composed of a rounded cap that flares outward at the opening. The surface of the bonnet has a smooth, velvety appearance, and it is adorned with two wide, flat ribbons that are laid out in a crisscross pattern on the side. There is also a large bow on the side near the base, with one long ribbon hanging vertically downward and another bow loop extending outward from the side. The interior of the bonnet appears to be the same color as the exterior. There are no additional objects or background details in the composition, keeping the focus entirely on the bonnet. The artist's signature appears faintly in the lower left corner.
title: Poke Bonnet
